sections.html: The Diamond tetra has been present in the hobby since 1933. Usually only bred specimens are available; only every now and then some wild-collected ones appear in the trade. At first glance the fish may look a bit unspectacular, but this is deceptive. In the right light the adult fish glitter and glimmer in a breathtaking way and show why they really deserve the name Diamond tetra.
The species is endemic to Lake Valencia in Venezuela (including some tributary rivers).
